decisions.reason: The delayed follow-up notice concerns the optional tip transaction, not the Transak fiat purchase, wallet provisioning, or NFT mint destination.
This Requirement governs feedback for the NFT mint result, while the new banner explains a separate post-mint tip transaction and is already owned by the optional-tip Requirement.
The source changes only the explanation of the optional tip's delayed transaction and does not change the ETH wallet mint flow.
The source does not change how a USDC mint is approved or completed; it adds notice for a separate optional tip transaction.
The tip confirmation banner does not alter ETH pricing, exact-output swap behavior, excess refunds, or insufficient-ETH handling.
The source adds explanatory UI for an optional gratuity but does not change the $30 mint price or its revenue allocation.
The source does not add, remove, enable, disable, or change disclosure of a checkout payment method.
Clarifying that a tip is not a second-copy purchase does not change the NFT ebook format or unlimited edition supply.
The client explicitly requests an in-flow confirmation banner, not a change to the product FAQ copy.
The source concerns optional-tip transaction messaging and does not resolve or alter ticket generation or allocation for no-referral mints.
The delayed tip notice does not change the NFT token serial used as the referral identity or any referral-code display location.
The source does not change commission amounts, triggers, or weighted recipient selection for purchases without referral codes.
